sample_method: From base-commit people with a selected destination, sort by SHA-256(seed + ':' + person_id), take first 16. Sample was chosen before inspecting sources.
scope: Repeated whole-dataset and export validation, existing same-day complete LinkedIn/participation audit, plus additional semantic review. Cached exact-profile evidence is explicitly identified and is not a new independent retrieval.
limitations: Not every external claim was independently reread in this repeat pass.
Prior all-302 LinkedIn retrieval had 14 failures and three retained conflicting or incomplete earlier profiles.
Page reachability and identity confidence do not prove continued employment, enrollment or residence.
Probable identities remain probable without an explicit Olympiad-to-career bridge.
